purpose: Calculates the yield strength σ_γ of Fe–Mn–C–Al austenite as a linear function of the Al solute weight percentage (Al_wt%).
applicability_conditions: Applicable to Fe–Mn–C–Al austenite (austenitic steel); describes the relation between Al solute content and yield strength in that austenite structure.

symbols.meaning: yield strength of the austenite (Fe–Mn–C–Al austenite structure)

unmapped: The coefficients 10.5 (slope) and 351.5 (intercept) are fitted/regression constants whose units are not stated in the provided context.
